sources.title: Traditional craftsmanship of the Mongol Ger and its associated customs
sources.access: UNESCO indexed page text read through web search on 2026-10-06; the subsequent direct open returned only a short response. The indexed text includes the full craft description and 2013 inscription.
supports: 2013 inscription
Portable construction, communal production and intergenerational transmission

politics.zh: 蒙古国位于中国与俄罗斯之间，首都为乌兰巴托。1990年的民主运动促成多党政治转型，1992年新宪法确立此后的制度框架；理解这一时期，需要把现代共和国与13世纪蒙古帝国、20世纪蒙古人民共和国分别考察。
politics.en: Mongolia lies between China and Russia, with Ulaanbaatar as its capital. The democratic movement of 1990 opened a transition to multiparty politics, followed by a new constitution in 1992. This modern republic belongs to a different institutional period from the medieval Mongol Empire and the twentieth-century Mongolian People's Republic.

economy.zh: 1990年代初，国营企业私有化与市场制度建设同时展开。世界银行对1993年的回顾记录了产出继续下降和高通胀，也指出进口管制、出口许可及集中采购对新兴私营部门的限制，显示制度转轨的具体困难。
economy.en: In the early 1990s, enterprise privatization proceeded alongside the construction of market institutions. The World Bank's retrospective on 1993 records continued output contraction and high inflation. It also identifies import controls, export licensing and centralized procurement as constraints on emerging private businesses, showing the institutional difficulties of transition.

culture.zh: 蒙古包的制作把木工、毡毯、缝纫和装饰结合起来，其可拆装结构适应牧户迁徙。技艺通过家庭协作和师徒传习延续，儿童也在搭建与拆卸中学习；这项工艺及相关习俗于2013年列入联合国教科文组织非物质文化遗产名录。
culture.en: The ger combines woodworking, felt-making, sewing and decoration in a dwelling that can be taken apart for pastoral migration. Household cooperation and apprenticeship transmit these skills, while children learn during assembly and dismantling. UNESCO inscribed the craftsmanship and associated customs on its intangible cultural heritage list in 2013.

events.zh: 1990年的民主转型、1992年新宪法以及随后的经济改革，构成现代蒙古国的一组相连节点。经济史可从1993年转轨困难继续追踪，社会文化史则可沿2013年蒙古包工艺入选名录，观察传统生活方式如何在现代制度中得到记录。
events.en: The democratic transition in 1990, the constitution of 1992 and subsequent economic reforms form a connected sequence in modern Mongolian history. The difficulties documented for 1993 offer an economic case study, while the 2013 heritage inscription provides a dated record of the recognition of pastoral craftsmanship.

value.zh: 1992年颁布新宪法。
value.en: A new constitution was adopted in 1992.

value.zh: 2013年蒙古包传统工艺及相关习俗列入UNESCO名录。
value.en: UNESCO inscribed ger craftsmanship and associated customs in 2013.

editorialNotes.zh: 本文讨论现代蒙古国。地图记录窗口为1992—2024年；2024只是当前收录末年。1990年作为制度转型背景，其他时代政权另列。
editorialNotes.en: This entry concerns modern Mongolia. The map-data window is 1992–2024; 2024 is only the last currently catalogued year. The 1990 transition is background, and earlier polities remain separate entries.

sources.title: Deoksugung: history of the imperial palace
sources.access: Source page read on 2026-10-06; section-level claim mapping accompanies this batch.
supports: Imperial palace from 1897
Traditional and Western buildings; 1904 fire; 1907 renaming and deposition

politics.zh: 1897年，高宗宣布建立大韩帝国，以皇帝称号重新表达国家地位。帝国延续朝鲜王朝的统治，同时开展光武改革；1905年受日本控制成为保护国，1910年被日本吞并，改革进程与主权丧失因而交织。
politics.en: Gojong proclaimed the Korean Empire in 1897, adopting an imperial title to express the state's standing. The monarchy continued from the Joseon dynasty while pursuing the Gwangmu reforms. Japanese control as a protectorate from 1905 and annexation in 1910 intertwined institutional reform with the loss of sovereignty.

economy.zh: 土地测量是光武改革的具体工程。1898年设立量地衙门，调查目标涉及农田、房屋、山林和道路；1899年汉城开始测量，各道另派人员处理丈量与文书，以重新掌握土地和财产状况。
economy.en: Land measurement was a concrete undertaking of the Gwangmu reforms. A dedicated survey office was established in 1898, with proposed investigations covering fields, houses, woodland and roads. Surveying began in Hansong in 1899, while provincial officials organized measurement and documentation to improve the state's knowledge of land and property.

culture.zh: 庆运宫成为帝国宫殿后，传统殿堂与西式建筑共同构成宫廷空间。1904年火灾后的重建、1907年改称德寿宫，使建筑群留下制度变化的痕迹；宫殿因此也是研究帝国礼仪与近代建筑相遇的具体地点。
culture.en: After Gyeongungung became the imperial palace, traditional halls and Western-style buildings shared its grounds. Reconstruction following the 1904 fire and its renaming as Deoksugung in 1907 left physical traces of political change. The complex offers a specific setting for studying the meeting of imperial ceremony and modern architectural forms.

events.zh: 1897年称帝、1898年设量地衙门、1905年沦为日本保护国及1910年被吞并，连接了帝国的建立、改革与终结。宫廷经历的1904年火灾和1907年高宗退位，则从首都空间补充了这条政治时间线。
events.en: The proclamation of empire in 1897, creation of the survey office in 1898, protectorate in 1905 and annexation in 1910 connect its foundation, reform and termination. The palace fire of 1904 and Gojong's deposition in 1907 add events situated in the capital to this political chronology.

value.zh: 1897年高宗宣布建立大韩帝国。
value.en: Gojong proclaimed the Korean Empire in 1897.

value.zh: 1910年帝国被日本吞并。
value.en: Japan annexed the empire in 1910.

editorialNotes.zh: 帝国的历史时期为1897—1910年，本站对应疆域记录始于1898年。土地调查方案的目标与已实施工作在正文中分别表述，不把计划等同于全国完成。
editorialNotes.en: The historical period is 1897–1910, whereas the corresponding map records begin in 1898. Proposed survey coverage is distinguished from work actually carried out.

sources.title: Pinya kingdom — Early Pinya, Government and Decline
sources.access: Source page read on 2026-10-06; section-level claim mapping accompanies this batch.
supports: Kyaukse granary, religious land and climatic pressures
Kyawswa I and the clergy; political chronology

politics.zh: 彬牙于1313年在缅甸中部建立，承接敏象政权并主张继承蒲甘王统。实皆的分离与王室内部竞争削弱中央权力；国王直接控制核心地区，对东吁、卑谬等外围地方的统治则多依赖附属关系。
politics.en: Founded in central Burma in 1313, Pinya succeeded Myinsaing and claimed continuity with the Pagan monarchy. Sagaing's separation and rivalry within the royal family weakened central authority. Kings governed a core region directly, while their relations with places such as Toungoo and Prome often amounted to nominal overlordship.

economy.zh: 彬牙位于皎施粮产区，王朝的资源基础与耕地分布紧密相连。宗教土地捐献缩小了王室可支配资源，14世纪的干旱和人口迁移又加重压力；争取僧团土地及其税源，是王权反复面对的问题。
economy.en: Pinya stood in the Kyaukse granary, tying royal resources closely to cultivated land. Donations of land to religious institutions reduced resources available to the crown, while dry conditions and migration added pressure during the fourteenth century. Attempts to recover resources from the clergy repeatedly exposed the limits of royal authority.

culture.zh: 佛教僧团在彬牙社会中既拥有宗教影响，也占有土地资源，王室与僧团的关系因而进入政治记载。觉苏瓦一世试图约束僧团势力却未成功；这一事例使宗教史能够与土地、宫廷合作和王权能力一起阅读。
culture.en: Buddhist clergy combined religious influence with control of landed resources in Pinya, making relations with monasteries part of political history. Kyawswa I's unsuccessful effort to restrain clerical power offers a concrete episode through which religious institutions, landholding and the court's limited capacity can be studied together.

events.zh: 实皆在1315—1317年争得自治，1325年正式分离。1358—1359年及1362—1363年的麓川进攻冲击彬牙乡村，1364年两座都城相继遭劫；德多明帕耶随后控制实皆和彬牙，1365年建立阿瓦。
events.en: Sagaing secured autonomy in 1315–1317 and formally separated in 1325. Maw attacks in 1358–1359 and 1362–1363 devastated Pinya's countryside, followed by the sack of both capitals in 1364. Thado Minbya subsequently took control of Sagaing and Pinya and founded Ava in 1365.

value.zh: 1313年建立彬牙王国。
value.en: Pinya was established in 1313.

value.zh: 1364年都城被控制，1365年阿瓦建立。
value.en: Its capital was taken in 1364; Ava was founded in 1365.

editorialNotes.zh: 来源记载的王国时期为1313—1365年，1364年已发生都城易手；本站三条疆域记录却覆盖1314—1374年，存在明确的末年冲突。叙述不能证明1366—1374年仍有彬牙王国。
editorialNotes.en: The source dates the kingdom to 1313–1365, with its capital taken in 1364. The atlas records span 1314–1374, creating a clear terminal-date conflict; this narrative supplies no evidence for a surviving Pinya kingdom in 1366–1374.

sources.title: 北山王國
sources.access: Read from the stored 3.36 introduction snapshot; stored pageprops identity equals Q55523. Snapshot reviewed on 2026-10-06; not a claim of a fresh page fetch.
supports: 北山以今归仁为中心
1416年今归仁被攻取

sources.title: 今帰仁城跡・よみがえる今帰仁城跡
sources.access: Source page read on 2026-10-06; section-level claim mapping accompanies this batch.
supports: Phase 3 dated mid-fourteenth to early fifteenth century
Chinese ceramics, rebuilding and subsequent phases

politics.zh: 北山是14世纪冲绳岛三山并立时的北部政权，以今归仁为中心。地方领主及其家臣构成统治基础，后世常以王国称之；1416年中山势力攻取今归仁后，北山的独立政治地位终结。
politics.en: Hokuzan was the northern polity in fourteenth-century Okinawa's three-part political order, centred on Nakijin. Local lords and their retainers formed its political base, although later accounts commonly call it a kingdom. Its independent political position ended when the forces of Chuzan took Nakijin in 1416.

economy.zh: 今归仁城14世纪中叶至15世纪初的地层出土大量中国陶瓷，村史研究将其与《明实录》中的三位山北王贸易记录联系起来。这些实物与文献相互对读，使北山的海外交换有了具体的地点和时代依据。
economy.en: Chinese ceramics occur in quantity in Nakijin Castle's layers dating from the mid-fourteenth to early fifteenth century. The village's archaeological account links them with trade by three northern rulers recorded in Ming sources. Comparing artifacts and documents gives overseas exchange a specific site and chronological setting.

culture.zh: 今归仁城的石垣、平整台地和柱础建筑，展现北山统治中心的营建方式。考古分期显示城内经过填土、扩建与建筑调整；把不同地层分开观察，能够追踪城堡空间的变化，而现存遗迹也包含王国结束后的继续使用。
culture.en: Nakijin's stone walls, levelled platforms and buildings on foundation stones reveal how the ruling centre was constructed. Archaeological phases identify successive infilling, enlargement and rebuilding. Reading these layers separately allows changes in castle space to be followed while recognizing that the surviving site also includes occupation after the kingdom ended.

events.zh: 北山与中山、南山共同构成14世纪冲绳岛的政治格局，王国与中国的贸易在文献和陶瓷遗存中留下痕迹。1416年今归仁陷落是其独立历史的终点，城址随后的使用与祭祀传统则属于另一个阶段。
events.en: Hokuzan, Chuzan and Nanzan formed Okinawa's political landscape in the fourteenth century. Written records and ceramic finds preserve traces of northern trade with China. Nakijin's fall in 1416 ended Hokuzan's independent history, while the site's subsequent occupation and ritual uses belong to later phases.

value.zh: 北山的统治中心为今归仁。
value.en: Nakijin was Hokuzan's ruling centre.

value.zh: 1416年中山势力攻取今归仁。
value.en: Chuzan's forces took Nakijin in 1416.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站两条疆域记录覆盖1314—1421年，但所读历史来源把独立北山的终结置于1416年；1417—1421年的几何显示应列为待核查的断代冲突。城址的晚期遗存另按考古分期理解。
editorialNotes.en: The two map records cover 1314–1421, while the read historical sources end independent Hokuzan in 1416. Geometry shown for 1417–1421 requires a dating review. Later remains at the castle belong to their own archaeological phases.

sources.title: Jin (Korean state) — History and Legacy
sources.access: Source page read on 2026-10-06; section-level claim mapping accompanies this batch.
supports: Uncertain political organization
Different later accounts of the relationship to Samhan

politics.zh: 辰国通常被理解为朝鲜半岛南部若干小国的联合体，活动时代大致在公元前4至前2世纪。它与北方古朝鲜相邻，政治中心的位置和统一程度仍有讨论；后来的三韩传统保存了对辰国的继承说法。
politics.en: Jin is generally understood as a confederacy of small polities in the southern Korean Peninsula, approximately in the fourth to second centuries BCE. It neighboured Gojoseon to the north. The location of its political centre and degree of unity remain debated, while later Samhan traditions preserve claims of succession.

economy.zh: 研究辰国时期的生产，可以从半岛南部的金属工艺入手。和顺大谷里出土的细形铜剑以分铸的剑身和剑柄组合，提供了早期铁器时代的技术实物；器物所属的考古时代清楚，但尚不足以恢复辰国的税制或国家财政。
economy.en: Production in Jin's period can be approached through southern peninsular metalworking. Bronze daggers from Daegok-ri in Hwasun combine separately cast blades and hilts, documenting Early Iron Age techniques. The artifacts provide material evidence for their archaeological period, although they do not establish Jin's taxation or state finances.

culture.zh: 辰国研究同时依靠后世文献与考古材料。文献中的辰韩、弁辰和辰王称号保存了辰的名称，细形铜剑则提供物质文化线索；这两类材料适合互相参照，具体族群、语言及政治边界仍须另作论证。
culture.en: Research on Jin combines later written accounts with archaeological material. The names Jinhan and Byeonjin and the title Jin king preserve its name, while slender bronze daggers offer material context. These bodies of evidence can be compared, but particular ethnic, linguistic and political boundaries require separate arguments.

events.zh: 辰国缺少可连续排列的君主与事件年表。现有文献讨论它同古朝鲜的往来，以及其后与马韩、辰韩、弁韩的关系；学习这一时期，更适合围绕政治联合和名称继承展开，精确的建国与灭亡年份仍待考证。
events.en: Jin lacks a continuous sequence of named rulers and securely dated events. The surviving accounts concern contacts with Gojoseon and later relationships with Mahan, Jinhan and Byeonhan. Political association and claims of succession therefore provide firmer study themes than a precise year-by-year chronology of foundation and collapse.

value.zh: 辰国通常被解释为半岛南部小国联合体。
value.en: Jin is commonly interpreted as a confederacy of southern peninsular polities.

value.zh: 大致时代为公元前4至前2世纪，确切起讫年存疑。
value.en: Its approximate period is the fourth to second centuries BCE; precise endpoints remain uncertain.

editorialNotes.zh: 这是证据有限的研究概览。细形铜剑只作为同时期区域背景，博物馆未将大谷里器物归属于辰国政权；经济栏没有国家财政资料。地图窗口前197—前92年也不是已证实的存续年表。
editorialNotes.en: This is an evidence-limited research overview. The daggers supply regional context; the museum does not attribute Daegok-ri to Jin as a polity. State fiscal evidence is unavailable in the consulted sources. The map window, 197–92 BCE, is not an established political lifespan.

sources.title: Early Lý dynasty — Resistance, Civil war and Sui invasion
sources.access: Source page read on 2026-10-06; section-level claim mapping accompanies this batch.
supports: Trieu Quang Phuc seizing military provisions from a marsh base
571 victory and 602 surrender

politics.zh: 李贲于544年称帝，国号万春，在今越南北部建立朝廷。这个政权在与梁朝的战争中多次转移据点，后来又出现李氏与赵光复的权力竞争；它的历史应放在红河地区的地方势力和南朝、隋朝的关系中阅读。
politics.en: Ly Bi proclaimed himself emperor in 544 and named his state Van Xuan, establishing a court in what is now northern Vietnam. Warfare with Liang forced changes of base, followed by competition between the Ly family and Trieu Quang Phuc. Its history connects Red River politics with the southern Chinese dynasties and Sui.

economy.zh: 所读材料对这一政权的全国生产和税收记载很少，较具体的是战争补给。赵光复以沼泽岛地为据点，袭取梁军物资后利用水道撤回；这条记载揭示资源获取与当地水网的关系，尚不能据此推算国家收入。
economy.en: The consulted sources say little about production or taxation across the state; wartime supply is more concrete. Trieu Quang Phuc operated from an island in marshland, taking Liang provisions and withdrawing through waterways. This account connects resource acquisition with local terrain without providing a measure of national revenue.

culture.zh: 越南国家历史博物馆的介绍把万春朝会建筑和开国寺联系到李贲时期。寺院后来迁往西湖一带，今天的地点经历了后续变化；沿建筑的创建、迁移与记忆追踪，比把现存寺貌直接当作6世纪遗存更有助于理解其历史。
culture.en: The Vietnam National Museum of History associates Van Xuan's court building and Khai Quoc Pagoda with Ly Bi's period. The pagoda later moved towards West Lake. Following foundation, relocation and commemoration gives a historical account of the site, whose present location and appearance reflect subsequent changes.

events.zh: 544年李贲称帝，随后梁军反攻，万春朝廷撤离原有都城。赵光复与李佛子的竞争改变了政权内部格局，571年李佛子取胜；602年隋军进攻后李佛子投降，前李朝的统治结束。
events.en: Ly Bi became emperor in 544, but a Liang counteroffensive forced the court from its original capital. Rivalry between Trieu Quang Phuc and Ly Phat Tu reshaped the polity, with the latter prevailing in 571. Following a Sui invasion in 602, Ly Phat Tu surrendered and Early Ly rule ended.

value.zh: 544年李贲称帝，国号万春。
value.en: Ly Bi became emperor in 544 and named the state Van Xuan.

value.zh: 英文来源将李佛子向隋投降定于602年。

editorialNotes.zh: 地图只收录546—601年的记录。英文资料采用544—602年，现有中文摘要把隋征服表述为602年末至603年初，属需进一步核对历法的断代差异。经济栏仅讨论有记载的军需，未补造税制。
editorialNotes.en: Map records cover only 546–601. The English account uses 544–602, while the stored Chinese summary places the Sui conquest in late 602 to early 603, a chronological difference requiring calendar review. The economic section is restricted to attested military supply.

sources.title: Old Chosŏn — Foundation traditions and Wiman Joseon
sources.access: Source page read on 2026-10-06; section-level claim mapping accompanies this batch.
supports: 194 BCE accession and 108 BCE conquest
Later transmission of the Dangun story

politics.zh: 古朝鲜是朝鲜半岛早期政权，后世加“古”字以区别1392年建立的朝鲜王朝。其早期发展同时涉及传说与历史记载；公元前194年卫满夺取王位，以及前108年汉朝征服卫满朝鲜，是较清楚的晚期政治节点。
politics.en: Gojoseon was an early Korean polity; the prefix meaning ancient distinguishes it from the Joseon dynasty founded in 1392. Accounts of its early development combine legend and historical testimony. Wiman's seizure of the throne in 194 BCE and the Han conquest in 108 BCE provide clearer landmarks for its later history.

economy.zh: 韩国国立博物馆以青铜时代农业发展、村落扩大和社会分化解释早期国家形成的背景，并陈列铜剑、陶器和钱币。将这些物证同古朝鲜的文献记载对照，可以研究生产、交换和地方势力成长，具体器物仍须核对各自年代与出土地。
economy.en: The National Museum of Korea explains early state formation through Bronze Age farming, growing settlements and social differentiation, alongside displays of bronze weapons, pottery and coins. Comparing such evidence with accounts of Gojoseon supports study of production, exchange and local power, with each artifact requiring its own date and provenance.

culture.zh: 檀君建国故事见于后世文献，并在朝鲜半岛的历史认同中持续流传。其公元前2333年纪年属于传说传统；学习古朝鲜文化时，可把故事的成文、传播与纪念，同考古材料反映的早期社会分别梳理。
culture.en: The Dangun foundation story was transmitted in later writings and continued to shape historical identity on the Korean Peninsula. Its date of 2333 BCE belongs to a legendary tradition. Studying the story's recording, transmission and commemoration alongside archaeology helps distinguish cultural memory from evidence for early society.

events.zh: 公元前194年卫满取得王位，形成古朝鲜历史的后期阶段。前108年汉武帝时期的战争结束卫满朝鲜，汉朝随后设郡；这组事件需要与檀君、箕子等早期起源叙事分开排列，避免把不同性质的年代并成同一条年表。
events.en: Wiman's accession in 194 BCE opened a later phase of Gojoseon's history. War under the Han emperor Wu ended Wiman Joseon in 108 BCE, followed by Han commanderies. These events require a separate chronological treatment from the Dangun and Gija origin traditions, whose dates rest on different kinds of evidence.

value.zh: 公元前194年卫满取得王位。
value.en: Wiman seized the throne in 194 BCE.

value.zh: 公元前108年汉朝征服卫满朝鲜。
value.en: Han conquered Wiman Joseon in 108 BCE.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站两条疆域记录覆盖前197—前92年，其中末年晚于来源所述前108年征服；前107—前92年的几何归属需要核查。博物馆的展厅涵盖多个早期政权，本文只借其阐释区域背景，不将全部展品归给古朝鲜。
editorialNotes.en: The two map records span 197–92 BCE, extending beyond the attested conquest in 108 BCE. Their attribution for 107–92 BCE requires review. The museum gallery covers several early polities; its broader context does not make every displayed object a Gojoseon artifact.

sources.title: Cao Wei — Culture
sources.access: Source page read on 2026-10-06; section-level claim mapping accompanies this batch.
supports: Zhong Yao and early regular script
Cao Zhi and Jian’an poetry

politics.zh: 曹丕于220年承接曹操在东汉末年的权力基础称帝，建立魏国。九品中正制成为选官制度的一环；249年高平陵政变后，司马氏逐步掌握实际权力，曹氏皇帝地位削弱，最终在266年让位于晋。
politics.en: Cao Pi became emperor in 220, building on Cao Cao's power at the end of the Han. The nine-rank system became part of official selection. After the coup of 249, the Sima family increasingly controlled government, weakening the Cao emperors before the transfer of the throne to Jin in 266.

economy.zh: 曹魏的经济基础可从建国前的屯田实践追溯。《三国志·任峻传》记载，军粮不足时在许下招募百姓耕作，并设置田官；官渡战事中的粮运保护又显示，农业组织与军队后勤紧密联系，是曹操政权扩展的重要条件。
economy.en: The economic foundations of Wei can be traced through agricultural colonies established before its formal foundation. Ren Jun's biography in the Sanguozhi describes recruiting cultivators near Xu and appointing agricultural officials during grain shortages. Its account of protecting supplies at Guandu connects organized production with the logistics of Cao Cao's expanding power.

culture.zh: 东汉末年至曹魏，诗歌和书法都出现可追踪的风格变化。曹植的诗作与建安文学相联系，魏臣钟繇则以早期楷书著称；从具体作者和作品传统切入，可以把文学、书写同当时的官僚与王室生活联系起来。
culture.en: From the late Han into Cao Wei, poetry and calligraphy developed recognizable styles. Cao Zhi is associated with Jian'an verse, while the Wei official Zhong Yao is known for early regular-script calligraphy. These named practitioners connect literary and scribal traditions with the world of officials and the ruling family.

events.zh: 220年曹丕称帝，249年司马懿发动高平陵政变，263年魏军灭蜀，266年司马炎代魏建晋，构成王朝的主要节点。建国前曹操的经营解释其兴起，249年后的权力转移则帮助理解为何曹氏国号尚存而司马氏已掌政。
events.en: Cao Pi's accession in 220, Sima Yi's coup in 249, the conquest of Shu in 263 and Sima Yan's establishment of Jin in 266 frame the dynasty. Cao Cao's earlier consolidation explains its origins; the later transfer of power explains why the Cao throne persisted after the Sima family gained control.

value.zh: 220年曹丕称帝，魏国建立。
value.en: Cao Pi became emperor and founded Wei in 220.

value.zh: 266年司马炎代魏建晋。
value.en: Sima Yan replaced Wei with Jin in 266.

editorialNotes.zh: 王朝时期采用220—266年；本站对应地图记录仅为224—264年。屯田段明确讨论曹操在东汉末年的建国前基础，没有把官渡战事放入220年以后。文化栏是一组可继续阅读的线索，而非全国文化的完整调查。
editorialNotes.en: The dynasty is dated 220–266, while this atlas provides corresponding map records only for 224–264. The agricultural-colony account explicitly concerns Cao Cao’s pre-foundation consolidation, not an event after 220. Cultural examples are study leads rather than a comprehensive survey.

note.zh: 本篇从1795年开始的统一进程讲到1893年王朝被推翻；1894年共和国成立及1898年并入美国作为后续背景。
note.en: This overview runs from the unification process beginning in 1795 to the overthrow of the monarchy in 1893. The republic of 1894 and annexation in 1898 are aftermath.

politics.zh: 夏威夷王国由卡美哈梅哈一世自1795年起逐步统一群岛，1810年完成全岛统一。19世纪逐步建立君主立宪体制，1840年与1852年颁布宪法，设立议会与法院。1887年宪法削弱王权，1891年利留卡拉尼女王继位后试图恢复权力，1893年被推翻，1894年成立共和国，1898年被美国兼并。
politics.en: The Hawaiian Kingdom was unified by Kamehameha I from 1795, completing the union of the islands in 1810. A constitutional monarchy developed in the nineteenth century with constitutions in 1840 and 1852, a legislature and courts. The 1887 constitution curtailed royal power, and when Queen Liliuokalani tried to restore it after 1891 she was overthrown in 1893; a republic followed in 1894 and the United States annexed the islands in 1898.

economy.zh: 19世纪的捕鲸航运推动拉海纳港口和商业发展，1860年代捕鲸业衰退后，蔗糖生产逐渐成为西毛伊的重要产业。中国契约劳工自1850年代来到种植园，部分人在合同结束后定居当地，形成持续发展的移民社群。
economy.en: Whaling supported Lahaina’s port and businesses during the nineteenth century. As whaling declined in the 1860s, sugar production became important in West Maui. Chinese contract workers arrived on plantations from the 1850s, and some settled locally after completing their contracts, contributing to lasting immigrant communities.

culture.zh: 夏威夷语与草裙舞、航海与土地观念构成原住民文化核心，19世纪传教士带来基督教与文字教育，夏威夷语成为书写语言并用于报纸与法律。王室赞助音乐与舞蹈，卡美哈梅哈家族与卡拉卡瓦家族留下宫廷传统。多元移民文化形成今天的夏威夷地方认同。
culture.en: The Hawaiian language, hula, navigation and land concepts form the core of Native Hawaiian culture. Missionaries brought Christianity and literacy in the nineteenth century, and Hawaiian became a written language used in newspapers and law. The monarchy patronised music and dance, and the Kamehameha and Kalakaua houses left court traditions. Immigrant cultures together shaped today's local Hawaiian identity.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1795年起统一进程、1810年全岛统一、1840与1852年宪法、1848年大土地分配、1875年与美国签订、1876年生效的互惠条约、1887年宪法、1893年政变，以及1894年共和国成立。
events.en: Key moments include the unification process from 1795, full unification in 1810, the constitutions of 1840 and 1852, the Great Mahele of 1848, the reciprocity treaty signed with the United States in 1875 and implemented in 1876, the constitution of 1887, the coup of 1893, and the republic of 1894.

summary.zh:
夏威夷王国由卡美哈梅哈一世自1795年起逐步统一群岛，1810年完成全岛统一。19世纪逐步建立君主立宪体制，1840年与1852年颁布宪法，设立议会与法院。1887年宪法削弱王权，1891年利留卡拉尼女王继位后试图恢复权力，1893年被推翻，1894年成立共和国，1898年被美国兼并。

19世纪的捕鲸航运推动拉海纳港口和商业发展，1860年代捕鲸业衰退后，蔗糖生产逐渐成为西毛伊的重要产业。中国契约劳工自1850年代来到种植园，部分人在合同结束后定居当地，形成持续发展的移民社群。

夏威夷语与草裙舞、航海与土地观念构成原住民文化核心，19世纪传教士带来基督教与文字教育，夏威夷语成为书写语言并用于报纸与法律。王室赞助音乐与舞蹈，卡美哈梅哈家族与卡拉卡瓦家族留下宫廷传统。多元移民文化形成今天的夏威夷地方认同。

note.zh: 本篇聚焦1923年丹吉尔公约至1956年地位安排，1923年是公约签订年。国际共管在第二次世界大战中的中断及1945年恢复另行说明。
note.en: This overview focuses on the 1923 Tangier Convention through the settlement of its status in 1956. The start is the convention date. Wartime interruption and restoration in 1945 are treated separately.

politics.zh: 丹吉尔位于摩洛哥北端，国际管理制度以英、法、西班牙1923年签订的公约为基础。西班牙于1940年占领该区，1945年恢复国际管理。1956年的九国会议议定结束国际制度的安排，最终宣言与议定书于10月29日签署。
politics.en: At Morocco’s northern tip, Tangier’s international regime rested on the convention signed by Britain, France and Spain in 1923. Spain occupied the zone in 1940; international administration was restored in 1945. A nine-power conference settled the regime’s termination in 1956, with a final declaration and protocol signed on 29 October.

economy.zh: 丹吉尔扼守大西洋与地中海之间的通道，港口位置使其具有突出的战略价值。1952年美国外交备忘录同时指出，美国对当地的贸易与投资规模很小；更重要的联系来自麦凯公司、美国无线电公司和美国之音的中继设施。这份材料提供了观察通信基础设施与国际政治联系的具体切口。
economy.en: Tangier’s position at the Atlantic–Mediterranean passage gave it strategic importance. A US diplomatic memorandum of 1952 described American trade and investment there as small, while emphasising relay facilities operated by Mackay, RCA and the Voice of America. The document offers a specific view of how communications infrastructure connected the city to international politics.

culture.zh: 作家保罗·鲍尔斯1947年定居丹吉尔，为城市的国际文学交往留下了重要线索。美国使馆博物馆保存相关展陈，也提供沿着作品、通信和音乐记录继续研究的入口。后来在1950年代末至1960年代到访的“垮掉的一代”作家，属于国际区结束后仍在延续的文化联系。
culture.en: The writer Paul Bowles settled in Tangier in 1947, an important thread in the city’s international literary connections. The American Legation Museum preserves related displays and offers paths into further study of writing, correspondence and music. Beat writers who arrived in the late 1950s and 1960s belong to the continuation of these contacts after the international zone ended.

events.zh: 1923年签订国际管理公约；1940年西班牙占领；1945年达成恢复国际管理的协议；1956年10月29日签署最终宣言与议定书。阅读时可把公约签订、制度恢复和制度结束三个节点分别对照档案。
events.en: The main milestones are the 1923 convention, Spanish occupation in 1940, the 1945 agreement restoring international administration, and the final declaration and protocol of 29 October 1956. These documents separate the creation of the legal framework, its restoration and its termination.

summary.zh:
丹吉尔位于摩洛哥北端，国际管理制度以英、法、西班牙1923年签订的公约为基础。西班牙于1940年占领该区，1945年恢复国际管理。1956年的九国会议议定结束国际制度的安排，最终宣言与议定书于10月29日签署。

丹吉尔扼守大西洋与地中海之间的通道，港口位置使其具有突出的战略价值。1952年美国外交备忘录同时指出，美国对当地的贸易与投资规模很小；更重要的联系来自麦凯公司、美国无线电公司和美国之音的中继设施。这份材料提供了观察通信基础设施与国际政治联系的具体切口。

作家保罗·鲍尔斯1947年定居丹吉尔，为城市的国际文学交往留下了重要线索。美国使馆博物馆保存相关展陈，也提供沿着作品、通信和音乐记录继续研究的入口。后来在1950年代末至1960年代到访的“垮掉的一代”作家，属于国际区结束后仍在延续的文化联系。

note.zh: 本篇从1960年达荷美独立讲起，涵盖后来的贝宁共和国；2024年是本篇资料截止年。
note.en: This overview begins with Dahomey’s independence in 1960 and includes the later Republic of Benin. Its coverage ends in 2024.

politics.zh: 贝宁共和国是西非国家，西邻多哥，东接尼日利亚，北连布基纳法索与尼日尔，南临几内亚湾，首都为波多诺伏。1960年脱离法国独立，旧称达荷美，1972至1990年经历军人执政与社会主义时期，1990年通过全国会议转向多党制，此后多次实现政党轮替。
politics.en: Benin, officially the Republic of Benin and formerly known as Dahomey, is a country in West Africa, bordered by Togo to the west, Nigeria to the east and Burkina Faso and Niger to the north, with the Gulf of Guinea to the south and Porto-Novo as its capital. It became independent from France in 1960 and, after a period of military rule and socialist government from 1972 to 1990, moved to multi-party politics through a national conference in 1990; it has since seen several changes of ruling party.

economy.zh: 农业、农产品加工、贸易与服务业是观察当代贝宁经济的重要线索。世界银行2024年报告指出，棉花和大豆出口推动当年第一季度的出口增长，农业、建筑与食品加工也支持了经济活动。科托努港的现代化及与尼日利亚、尼日尔的贸易联系关系到服务业发展；边境中断、洪水和干旱则带来风险。
economy.en: Agriculture, agro-food processing, trade and services are important to understanding contemporary Benin. The World Bank’s October 2024 report linked first-quarter export growth to cotton and soybeans, with farming, construction and food processing also supporting activity. Cotonou port modernisation and trade links with Nigeria and Niger matter for services, while border disruption, floods and drought create risks.

culture.zh: 阿波美王宫保存了达荷美的宫廷文化遗产。土墙、院落和彩色浮雕体现阿贾—丰文化传统，宫殿曾兼具决策、工艺制作和珍宝保存的功能。今日博物馆与传统仪式让这段历史继续进入贝宁的公共文化生活。
culture.en: The royal palaces at Abomey preserve the court heritage of Dahomey. Earthen walls, courtyards and coloured reliefs express Aja-Fon traditions. The palaces combined political decision-making, craft production and storage of royal treasures. Museum displays and continuing ceremonies keep this heritage present in Benin’s cultural life.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1960年独立、1972年军人执政与社会主义时期、1990年全国会议转向多党制，以及此后的多次政党轮替与选举。
events.en: Key moments are independence in 1960, the military takeover and socialist period from 1972, the national conference of 1990 that introduced multi-party politics and the changes of ruling party and elections since then.

editorialNotes.zh: 疆域源在1961—2024年间收录3条记录，正文则从1960年独立展开。阿波美王宫的达荷美传统与今尼日利亚贝宁城的贝宁王国分开记述。
editorialNotes.en: The source holds three boundary records dated 1961–2024, while the overview begins with independence in 1960. Dahomey’s Abomey court heritage is kept distinct from the Kingdom of Benin centred on Benin City in present-day Nigeria.
